scores.visual_critic_note: Deliberate dark theme with consistent blue accent, clear typographic hierarchy via uppercase panel labels, and a well-structured grid layout — but the 9px network node labels are unreadable at render size and the thumbnail gallery feels cramped.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Timeline and color scatter use correct zero baselines and scaleSqrt for size encoding, but the network panel recalculates node-size domain against the filtered-subset max (rFiltered domain [0, maxFilteredCount]) rather than the global max, violating subset invariance and causing nodes to visually grow when peers are filtered out.
scores.stress_test_note: RAF dirty-flag pattern correctly coalesces DOM updates, no infinite loops (brush updaters exclude own layer), no D3 transitions (no mid-flight race), and pointer events unify mouse/touch — primary weakness is O(N) bitFilter recomputation on every mousemove and stale scale closures on resize.
scores.cognitive_load_note: The 4-panel crossfilter layout is manageable, but the network panel renders 60 nodes with high-density co-occurrence edges that form a near-hairball — the centerpiece view fails to reveal cluster structure at a glance, undermining the primary insight the dashboard is built around.
